name: BTC & ETH CME Futures Basis Analysis
description: Research study analyzing the basis (CME futures price minus spot price) and annualized basis rate for Bitcoin (BT) and Ethereum (ER) futures vs their spot prices (BTCUSD, ETHUSD). The annualized basis rate serves as a proxy for the implied funding/carry rate. Uses NoAdjustment on futures continuation to preserve true price levels for meaningful basis computation. Outputs: cross-sectional summary table with current and average basis metrics, per-asset funding rate chart, and per-asset basis chart.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BTC & ETH CME FUTURES BASIS ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Computes basis (CME futures - spot) and annualized basis rate (implied
# funding/carry proxy) for Bitcoin and Ethereum.
#
# Data:
#   - CME Bitcoin Futures (BT) via reference_futures + futures_continuation
#   - CME Ether Futures (ER) via reference_futures + futures_continuation
#   - Spot BTC and ETH via common_crypto_pairs
#   - NoAdjustment used to preserve true price levels for basis calculation
#
# Metrics:
#   - Basis = Futures Close - Spot Close
#   - Basis % = Basis / Spot Close
#   - Annualized Basis % = Basis % * (365 / DTE)  (implied funding rate proxy)
#   - Average annualized basis over study period
# =============================================================================

# --- CME Bitcoin Futures (reference data, not primary asset) ---
bt_raw = reference_futures(ticker="BT")()
bt_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(bt_raw.o, bt_raw.h, bt_raw.l, bt_raw.c, bt_raw.v, bt_raw.oi, bt_raw.s)
bt_fut_close = bt_cont.c
bt_dte = bt_cont.dte

# --- CME Ether Futures (reference data, not primary asset) ---
er_raw = reference_futures(ticker="ER")()
er_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(er_raw.o, er_raw.h, er_raw.l, er_raw.c, er_raw.v, er_raw.oi, er_raw.s)
er_fut_close = er_cont.c
er_dte = er_cont.dte

# --- Spot Crypto Prices ---
btc_spot = common_crypto_pairs(ticker=ReferenceCryptoPair.BTCUSD)()
btc_spot_close = btc_spot.c

eth_spot = common_crypto_pairs(ticker=ReferenceCryptoPair.ETHUSD)()
eth_spot_close = eth_spot.c

# --- Basis Calculations (Futures - Spot) ---
# BTC basis
bt_basis = bt_fut_close - btc_spot_close
bt_basis_pct = bt_basis / btc_spot_close
bt_ann_basis = bt_basis_pct * (365.0 / bt_dte)

# ETH basis
er_basis = er_fut_close - eth_spot_close
er_basis_pct = er_basis / eth_spot_close
er_ann_basis = er_basis_pct * (365.0 / er_dte)

# --- Smoothed annualized basis (30-day MA) ---
bt_ann_basis_ma = ma(period=30)(bt_ann_basis)
er_ann_basis_ma = ma(period=30)(er_ann_basis)

# --- Route per-asset data using conditional_select ---
is_btc = is_asset_ref(ticker="BTCUSD")()
is_eth = is_asset_ref(ticker="ETHUSD")()

# Per-asset annualized basis (implied funding proxy)
ann_basis = conditional_select(is_btc, bt_ann_basis, is_eth, er_ann_basis, 0.0 / 0.0)
ann_basis_ma = conditional_select(is_btc, bt_ann_basis_ma, is_eth, er_ann_basis_ma, 0.0 / 0.0)

# Per-asset raw basis ($)
basis_usd = conditional_select(is_btc, bt_basis, is_eth, er_basis, 0.0 / 0.0)

# Per-asset basis %
basis_pct = conditional_select(is_btc, bt_basis_pct, is_eth, er_basis_pct, 0.0 / 0.0)

# Average annualized basis over study period
avg_ann_basis = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(ann_basis)

# --- Timestamp for chart x-axis ---
bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# 1. Cross-Sectional Summary Table: per-asset basis metrics
cs_summary_table(
    title='CME Futures Basis Summary',
    category='1. Basis Overview',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='CME Futures Basis Summary',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Current Basis ($)', type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Current Basis (%)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Annualized Basis (Current)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Annualized Basis', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    order=0
)(basis_usd, basis_pct, ann_basis, avg_ann_basis)

# 2. Per-Asset: Annualized Basis Rate Over Time (implied funding proxy)
xy_lines(
    title='Annualized Basis Rate (Implied Funding Proxy)',
    category='2. Funding Rate',
    y_axis_label='Annualized Rate',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Annualized Basis', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='30d Moving Average', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(bar_ts, ann_basis, ann_basis_ma)

# 3. Per-Asset: Basis in USD Over Time
xy_lines(
    title='CME Futures Basis (Futures - Spot)',
    category='3. Basis',
    y_axis_label='Basis ($)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Basis ($)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=2
)(bar_ts, basis_usd)
